verdict.headline: Not supported in this run: no theory arm gained held-out ability beyond the DRIFT noise floor.
reasons: COOP: held-out ability changed -0.005 (per seed -0.141, -0.028, +0.136, +0.041, -0.033). Above DRIFT noise: no. Above SOLO baseline: no. All seeds up: no.
DOMEST: held-out ability changed -0.103 (per seed -0.113, +0.049, -0.098, -0.063, -0.291). Above DRIFT noise: no. Above SOLO baseline: no. All seeds up: no.
CULTURE: held-out ability changed +0.105 (per seed +0.127, +0.150, +0.102, +0.099, +0.045). Above DRIFT noise: no. Above SOLO baseline: no. All seeds up: yes.
MEDLEY: held-out ability changed +0.001 (per seed +0.104, +0.134, -0.101, -0.025, -0.107). Above DRIFT noise: no. Above SOLO baseline: no. All seeds up: no.
DRIFT (noise floor): mean change +0.047, band +/- 0.175 from 5 seeds.
SOLO (ecology only): mean change +0.102. Above DRIFT noise: no.
verdict.rule: Supported needs at least two theory arms whose mean change is above the DRIFT noise band, above the SOLO baseline by more than that band, and positive in every seed. Not supported means no theory arm is above the noise band. Anything else is unclear.

for: Ability rose with no reward for ability in the two arms where agents forage alone. SOLO gained +0.102 and CULTURE +0.105, positive in 5 of 5 and 5 of 5 seeds. Both are inside the DRIFT noise band of 0.175, so this is a consistent direction, not a confirmed effect.
Memory is what moved. MEM rose +1.49 in SOLO and +1.60 in CULTURE, upward in every seed, against +0.16 under chance alone. The gap is inside the noise band of 1.76.
Selection behaved as designed. Every costly gene that an arm could not use fell, and grabbing rose where nothing punished it.
Inherited notes transformed foraging. CULTURE success went from 0.23 to 0.75 while SOLO reached 0.36, so knowledge accumulated across generations without any change to the model.
against: No theory arm beat plain ecology. The best theory arm, CULTURE, gained +0.105 in held-out ability; SOLO, with no social mechanism at all, gained +0.102.

Social life selected against costly cognition. Total capacity changed -1.79 in COOP, -1.11 in ALPHA, -2.49 in DOMEST, -2.08 in MEDLEY. All four are beyond the DRIFT noise band of 0.98, and three of them fell in every seed.

Message length never paid for itself. TALK fell in every arm with selection, including the paired arms where it is usable. Within a generation, longer messages went with lower net energy: correlation -0.11 in COOP, -0.11 in ALPHA, -0.20 in DOMEST, -0.17 in MEDLEY.
Cultural gain did not become ability gain. CULTURE tripled its foraging success, yet LORE moved only +0.11 and its held-out gain matched SOLO.
The self-domestication arm lost ability: -0.103, the largest drop of any arm, though still inside the noise band.
untested: Theory 3 was not tested. The exile vote removed 0 members in 120 generations. About 1 of 16 members named anyone per generation, and exile needed 4 votes against one member, while about 36 grabs happened per generation. The frozen model declined to punish.
With no exile, DOMEST was ALPHA plus a public board. Grabbing rose +1.15 with the vote and +0.71 without it, which says nothing about whether real punishment would lower it.

One cost setting. Each capacity level cost 1.5 energy per lifetime, so the average starting genome paid 8.0 in upkeep, and 5 of 7 arms began with net energy below zero. A cheaper brain could reverse the capacity losses in the social arms. This run cannot say.
Ability can only follow MEM and TALK. The held-out score is read from those two genes, so nothing an arm does to LORE or to the notes themselves can register as ability.
